From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps / scheduling

Hi Sanjay —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the sizing call on the calendar: 

Recap from discovery:
- Expected production workload: customer support assistant (multi-turn chat) + light batch embedding jobs for search
- Typical request: ~600 tokens input, ~400 tokens output (average ~1k tokens per request)
- Target SLO: p95 latency <= 500ms for interactive flows
- Peak concurrency estimate: ~40 concurrent users during peak (roughly 30–50 QPS depending on batching)

What we need for the dedicated capacity sizing call:
1) Block 45–60 minutes for a technical sizing session (include your ML/Infra contacts)
2) Walk through the attached capacity_sizing_template.xlsx with your expected traffic profiles
3) Confirm model family(s) you plan to serve (e.g., Llama-3 70B, Mistral-like) and whether you need quantized variants
4) Share any data residency/network requirements that would affect placement

Proposed times (PST):
- Monday 6/22 09:00–10:00
- Tuesday 6/23 11:00–12:00
- Wednesday 6/24 14:00–15:00

If those don't work, send a few times that do and we will align. I’ve cc'd Neha (sales engineer) to join and Vivek (solutions) as backup for infra questions.

Attachment: capacity_sizing_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmeai.com>

Cc: Laura Chen <laura@acmeai.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps / scheduling

Thanks Marissa — great overview and thanks for the template. A few quick clarifications before we lock time:
- The 1k tokens per request is a good average for chat; we may spike higher for long context retrieval but those are infrequent.
- For models we're evaluating Mistral-like 70B and a 13B optimized variant for lower latency. We are interested in quantized options if they maintain quality.
- SRE will join: Laura (cc'd) and our infra lead Sanjay Patel (sanjay.patel@acmeai.com) — he might hop on as well.

We can do Tuesday 6/23 11:00–12:00 PST. I’ll have Laura, Sanjay P., and myself on the call. I filled the first tab of the template with our rough hourly distribution and attached it back — see inline answers.
